comparison.objective: Use a messenger line to haul a dock-line eye across a gap and place it over a bollard; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Mooring tests deformable-line hauling and loop placement. Candidate is a rigid-body fine-tool, rotational adjustment, and force-limited locking task.
comparison.success_condition: The eye must be released over the bollard with the dock line hauled across; candidate must pass two safe impact cycles and a witness-torque retention test.
comparison.reason: Deformable line manipulation and rigid damper adjustment are materially different.
